game_title: Rounding Range – Ash Rim Trail Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail, the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre: the fire warden must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Rounding Range: Use round() and abs() to snap messy measurements into valid slots.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail: the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre
core_gameplay_loop: In Ash Rim Trail, repeat each round: Use round() and abs() to snap messy measurements into valid slots. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the slot_matches value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the magma valve using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The magma valve reached with actions_used <= 18.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the magma valve is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 9 (extended tier): Rounding Range
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rounding Range' (Week 2 slot 13), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Ash Rim Trail'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how slot_matches changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against magma slimes in Ash Rim Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The magma valve reached with actions_used <= 18.
